reviews.title: Stops working after some updates
reviews.text: The recent updates for the Apple version of this app stop it from working. Three times in the last 4 months this has happened, and the only resolve is to delete the app and download it again. That’s easy enough for me to do, but frustrating for the Grandparents who have to do this on their iPads every couple weeks.

reviews.title: Lack of storage
reviews.text: I am paying for extra storage but they still don’t have the extra storage capacity available and keeps saying extra storage is coming but they has done so for several months. No one replies to your questions or when the upgrade in storage is coming.

reviews.title: Great App, but…
reviews.text: The App has been great, but when you close your account they continue to charge you, so make sure you cancel your subscription on your side. Once account is closed you can’t get hold of them either! It’s a shame to end this way given the years I’ve been with them :(

reviews.title: Too Expensive and get your ads for products off my screen
reviews.text: I’m only using this because some family can’t use Shared Albums on the iOS Photos app

reviews.title: Cost too much!
reviews.text: Do NOT download. The cost has gotten out of hand. It’s not worth it.
